en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square framed by old masonry houses. At the center stands a large, roughly square building with a steep hipped slate roof and a clock tower topped by a lantern and spire. The façade has classical details over the corner doorways. A horse‑drawn cart stands in the street, and a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing are visible. Trees and a wrought‑iron fence border the right side of the square. The overall look suggests an older European market town or small city hall. No visible caption or border text is present on the image side.
